customManagers.description: Track the MacPorts macports-legacy-support pin (REF + commit DIGEST). Renovate moves REF and DIGEST together; the pins bot writes TARBALL_SHA256 on the Renovate branch.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves REF and DIGEST of the MacPorts pin but cannot compute the SHA-256 of GitHub's tarball of that commit; the pins bot (.github/workflows/pins-bot.yml) writes TARBALL_SHA256 on the branch.
prBodyNotes: The MacPorts tarball's SHA-256 is written on this branch by .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml. If that bot failed, run `sh build/pin-source-tarball.sh` on this branch and commit components/macports-legacy-support/version.
